ex.en: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.
ex.zh: 他又累又睡眠不足，最後終於病倒了。

ex.en: Fatigue is a common symptom of the flu.
ex.zh: 疲倦是流感的常見症狀。

ex.en: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是非常狂熱的足球迷。

ex.en: There were a lot of excited fans in the stadium.
ex.zh: 體育場裡有很多興奮的球迷。

ex.en: The fans all hope the club changes the manager.
ex.zh: 球迷都希望球隊換掉總教練。

ex.en: It's warm, so I turned on the electric fan.
ex.zh: 天氣很熱，所以我打開了電風扇。

ex.en: The ceiling fan keeps the room cool.
ex.zh: 吊扇讓房間保持涼爽。

ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
ex.zh: 工廠下週可能會關閉。

ex.en: Automobiles are made in factories.
ex.zh: 汽車是在工廠裡製造的。

ex.en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每週的產能是 250 輛車。

ex.en: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有很棒的運動設施。

ex.en: The company opened a new research facility.
ex.zh: 公司開設了一座新的研究中心。

ex.en: What is the fare from Osaka to Akita?
ex.zh: 從大阪到秋田的車費是多少？

ex.en: Taxi fares will go up next month.
ex.zh: 計程車費將在下個月漲價。

ex.en: How much is the bus fare?
ex.zh: 公車票價多少錢？

ex.en: How far is it from here to the museum?
ex.zh: 這裡離博物館多遠？

ex.en: How far is it to the library from here?
ex.zh: 圖書館離這裡有多遠？

ex.en: Tim's motorbike is far more expensive than mine is.
ex.zh: 提姆的機車比我的貴多了。

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你菸抽得太多了，應該少抽一點。

ex.en: School has started and I like it so far.
ex.zh: 開學了，目前感覺還不錯。

ex.en: So far, everything is going well.
ex.zh: 到目前為止，一切都很順利。

ex.en: The new software will facilitate communication between teams.
ex.zh: 新軟體能讓各團隊之間的溝通更順暢。

ex.en: Good lighting facilitates reading.
ex.zh: 良好的照明讓閱讀更輕鬆。

ex.en: Anna will facilitate today's workshop.
ex.zh: 今天的工作坊由安娜主持。

ex.en: A good leader facilitates discussion instead of dominating it.
ex.zh: 好的領導者會帶領討論，而不是主導發言。
